# The Independent

> Independent news organization providing comprehensive coverage of US, UK, and global affairs with editorial focus on journalism ethics and geopolitical analysis.

The Independent delivers international news across multiple regions including the US, UK, China, India, Japan, and Middle East, alongside coverage of politics, business, technology, and lifestyle. The publication emphasizes editorial independence and maintains strict journalism standards across all reporting.

## Key Topics

- International News
- US Politics
- UK News
- Middle East Conflict
- China Geopolitics
- Donald Trump
- Keir Starmer
- Editorial Standards
- Journalism Ethics
- Asia-Pacific Coverage

- Technology & AI
- Business & Economy
- Israel-Iran Relations
- Independent Journalism

## Core News Sections

- [Homepage](https://theindependent.co): Main hub featuring international news coverage including US, UK, and world news
- [US News](https://theindependent.co/news/us): US news coverage including Trump administration and immigration policy
- [US Politics](https://theindependent.co/news/us-politics): US politics news with election coverage and campaign analysis
- [UK News](https://theindependent.co/news/uk): UK news coverage including Keir Starmer and British politics
- [Middle East](https://theindependent.co/news/middle_east): Middle East conflict coverage including Israel-Iran relations and Gaza

## Global & Regional Coverage

- [China News](https://theindependent.co/news/china-news): China news including geopolitics and US-China relations coverage
- [India News](https://theindependent.co/news/india-news): India news covering diplomatic relations and regional politics
- [Japan News](https://theindependent.co/news/japan-news): Japan news including politics, elections, and current affairs
- [Travel](https://theindependent.co/news/travel): Travel news with hotel reviews and Asia-Pacific destination coverage

## Business, Technology & Lifestyle

- [Technology](https://theindependent.co/news/technology): Technology news covering AI, DeepSeek, Meta, and cybersecurity
- [Business & Economy](https://theindependent.co/news/business-economy): Business and economy news covering Tesla, ASEAN, and investment trends
- [Personal Finance](https://theindependent.co/news/personal-finance): Personal finance news covering wealth mindset and financial resilience
- [Entertainment](https://theindependent.co/news/entertainment): Entertainment news featuring celebrity gossip and podcast coverage
- [Lifestyle](https://theindependent.co/news/lifestyle): Lifestyle news featuring Singapore events, wellness, and consumer trends
